channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: The Valcour emergency system outage in Vermont continues into its second week. Dispatchers are manually entering data while officials evaluate alternative systems. Phone lines and emergency responses remain unaffected during the outage.

Rutland's mayor is reviewing safety at Sheldon Towers after a fire and drug bust. The ten-story public housing complex was evacuated due to an oven fire. Housing officials are updating evacuation plans and boosting security.

New York is investing forty-five million dollars to plant twenty-five million trees by twenty thirty-three and reforest millions of acres. Grants support nurseries, workforce growth, and sustainable forest markets, including projects in the Adirondacks. The initiative aims to boost tree supply and demand statewide.

Base Camp at Bear Mountain is rising this winter in Killington. The development includes twenty-four luxury townhomes with four bedrooms each. The first homes are set to be completed in twenty twenty-seven with slopeside access.
